title: The toll doubles tomorrow
scenario: A text says you owe $6.40 in unpaid tolls and warns the fee becomes $75 tomorrow and may affect vehicle registration. You drove on toll roads last week.

answers.A: Call the toll agency using a known number and ask them to search your plate/account.
answers.B: Pay through the text link because the amount is plausible and you did use toll roads.
answers.C: Use your toll account or the toll agency website you navigate to independently to check for an actual balance.

explanation: Real-world context makes toll smishing effective. The toll authority can verify debt without using the text link.
proTip: Recent driving makes the story plausible, not authenticated.
